summary:
Unified file exploration and file opening across all panels in GVONE Browser:
1. Created UnifiedFileExplorerView with subfolder drilling, back navigation, path breadcrumbs, storage location selectors, and instant in-place file previews.
2. Updated SafariActionsSheet and XcodeInspectorPanel with the Files tab hosting UnifiedFileExplorerView.
3. Enhanced IdeSidebar with subfolder navigation, folder breadcrumbs, back-to-parent button, and folder drilling.
4. Added image rendering with ImageFileViewer to XcodeWorkspaceEditor and GVONEIdeScreen so images display with path, zoom, and metadata instead of binary string corruption.
5. Unified TabOverviewScreen to support folder drilling with breadcrumbs and back button, image thumbnails in cards, image preview in dialog, and live tab launch via onOpenFileInTab for image files.
